o_splash.description: Splash screen mode: '0' to disable, 'woordryk' for verbose, 'stil' for silent with progress bar

o_apm.description: APM status: 'af' to disable, 'aan' to enable

o_acpi.description: ACPI status: 'af' to disable, 'dwang' to force on (even on old BIOS), 'ouselflaai' for boot-only, 'aan' for default

o_ide.description: IDE kernel parameter: 'geendma' to disable DMA, empty or other string for other settings
